application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of single storey rear extension following the demolition of the existing, enlargement of the existing rear roof extension and replacement of the front roof light
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PL01, PL02, PL03, PL04, PL05, PL06, PL07, PL08 received 7 June 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
